text: A Kenyan presidential aspirant just told Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote to pack his bags.
Patrick Osoi said that once he is sworn in, in twenty twenty-seven, Dangote will be heading back to Nigeria.
This is about Dangote's planned sixteen billion dollar refinery in Lamu.
Everyone expected Nigerians to fight back.
If you want to chase him, chase him.
We never benefited from him anyway.
Dangote should fight his own battles.
Now Dangote has no option but to fund his opponent's campaign.
Remember, this is a campaign promise, not government policy.
